## 6. Content-standards conformance

Pass. Diagrams are Mermaid; the MCP box-drawing block is a directory tree. No applicable heading or mathematics defect found.

## Findings

1. **F1 — The individual API-container instructions omit mandatory repository initialization.** [INSTALL.md:111](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/INSTALL.md:111) mounts a new `jit-data` volume and starts `jit-server`, but the API server rejects an uninitialized data directory. Add a preceding CLI-container `jit init` command for `jit-data`, or require mounting an existing initialized repository.

2. **F2 — The all-in-one container is documented as serving the Web UI, but its image copies assets to nginx’s wrong directory.** [INSTALL.md:152](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/INSTALL.md:152) promises API and UI together, while `Dockerfile:65` copies `dist` to `/var/www/html` and `docker/nginx.conf:36` serves `/usr/share/nginx/html`. Replace this with the working Compose/separate-container flow, or describe the image as API-only until its image layout is corrected.

3. **F3 — The README overstates gate-stage enforcement.** [README.md:138](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/README.md:138) and [README.md:160](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/README.md:160) say gates/prechecks must pass before work starts, but `jit issue update --state in_progress` does not run prechecks; transition guards enforce gates only on `done`. State that prechecks run through `jit issue claim`, and retain the unconditional completion requirement.

Total findings: 3
